description: Evidence manifest for proving the initial central DB migration was applied to a PostgreSQL platform database and matches central_db_schema.v1.json. FE-P0a (2026-05-25) extends the schema with measurement_attempts (append-only + is_latest + attempt_number + condition_hash + operator), measurement_results.project_id/condition_hash/operator, claim_events, project_membership (reserved for FE-P8), the coverage_by_condition_hash materialized view (refresh: on_ingest + PT1H fallback), and the active_claims view; deployed evidence must cover every table listed in the schema SSOT.
coverage_rules: schema_contract_sha256 and ddl_sha256 must be 64-character lowercase SHA-256 hex digests.
Every table in docs/platform/central_db_schema.v1.json must be present (including FE-P0a measurement_attempts, claim_events, project_membership).
Every schema column must be present in the matching table evidence.
Required schema columns must be reported as nullable=false.
Every schema index must be present with matching columns and unique flag.
Evidence must not include extra tables outside the schema SSOT.

FE-P0a append-only ledgers (measurement_attempts, claim_events) must be writable by INSERT only at the application boundary; evidence collectors should note any UPDATE/DELETE grant on these tables in details_json.

FE-P0a materialized view coverage_by_condition_hash and view active_claims are Postgres objects whose presence is enforced by the schema contract; deployed evidence is reported via table evidence today but a future collector iteration may capture them separately.
notes: This contract validates captured evidence only. The future platform repository should add a DB introspection collector that writes this manifest after applying migrations.

adr_alignment.alignment: FE-P0a aligns the migration evidence schema with ADR-0005 by formally including measurement_attempts/claim_events/project_membership in the required-table coverage. The ADR-0005 open issue (line 158-162, 'materialized view refresh 정책 결정 필요') is resolved by central_db_schema.v1.json::refresh_policies.coverage_by_condition_hash and reflected in the ADR body.
